title: Can I use any resource from any RPG maker series?

posts.author: xclnth
posts.body:
such as sound effects, music, chipsets, facesets, etc etc etc for commercial use?
RM2K, RM2K3, RM MV, RM XP, RM MZ, RM ACE, or RM VX

posts.author: Robro33
posts.body:
if you own the engine its from, youre allowed to use the assets.
but keep in mind that asset standards and formats changed a couple times between engines. some manual adjustments and conversions may need to be made when transferring assets from one engine to another

posts.author: xclnth
posts.body:
Thanks for the information!
Yes, I was aware of having to convert it to make work.

posts.author: ZombieKidzRule
posts.body:
This is one of the reasons why many people might choose to buy all the maker versions when they go on sale for ridiculously low prices. You have access to not only everything that comes with the version, but also any free assets that are built off those default assets. And there are a lot.
Good luck on your projects!

posts.author: xclnth
posts.body: Yeah, I've already bought all of them long ago that's why I was wondering if I could.
